meaning:
ἀπο-τελέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: I Est.5:73, 1Ma.15:39 * ;]
to bring to an end, complete, accomplish (cf. MM, see word): Luk.13:32, Jas.1:15.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
